title: Chapter 28: Preparedness and Confession
content:
Chapter 28:

Confession and Determination

“——Finally, you’ve noticed, in fact.”

When Subaru opened his eyes, the sunlight was leaning heavily toward the west.

Midway up the cliff—that place Subaru had arrived at during his first fall was gaping open like a mouth where the forest broke off.

He hadn’t had the composure to notice it during the chaotic battle with the beast, but placing himself here where he could see the sky, an inexplicable sense of relief wrapped around Subaru.

Perhaps the illusion of having escaped the suffocating feeling of being surrounded by trees made him think so. To the extent that a self-righteous hope floated up that maybe, even in this dead-end situation that should have remained unchanged, something might have changed.

“Why don’t you say something, I wonder?”

“……Something.”

“On top of being boring, you have a stale, gloomy look on your face; you are a hopeless guy, in fact.”

Spitting that out harshly, Beatrice smoothed down her long, luxurious ringlets.

Atop the rocky surface of the sheer cliff, the incongruity of her usual dress attire was tremendous; there was a mismatch there as if only her part had been pasted onto a landscape painting later.

“……In that getup, I can’t really picture you doing outdoorsy stuff.”

“Betty didn’t want to walk in the dirt-smelling mountains either, in fact. If you hadn’t fled into a place like this, there would have been no need to come here, I suppose.”

Brushing off her hem, Beatrice said this bitterly.

At her words, Subaru furrowed his brows suspiciously, and then, belatedly, he realized.

That the multitude of deep wounds he had sustained were mostly closed, leaving only traces like bloodstains and tears in his clothes.

The left wrist that had been nearly falling off, the laceration on his right arm where bone had been visible, the right leg he had hallucinated was no longer moving—all of it was back to normal.

“There were too many, so I couldn’t erase the scars, in fact. You should accept at least that much as the result of your own clumsiness, I suppose.”

If he looked closely, he could confirm the remnants of wounds received from fangs in various places. However, they had faded enough that one wouldn’t notice unless in a bright place, and above all, he didn’t care about his appearance enough to worry about scars.

Purely, the fact that he had his wounds healed like this was the greatest salvation. However,

“Why……”

“What is it, I wonder?”

“Why did you save me? I……”

——Even to Beatrice, who had formed a contract with him, he couldn’t reveal anything.

At Subaru’s attitude of choking on his words, Beatrice snorted with a familiar look of amazement. She shrugged her shoulders just like that,

“If the other party were to die in an unsightly pool of blood, it would affect Betty’s prestige, I suppose..”

“I thought the terms said… until this morning.”

“If you have the composure to nitpick, I could make a wound in the same place again for you, in fact? Fittingly, there is a target called a scar to aim for, I suppose.”

“

I’msorrythankyoupleaseforgiveme

.”

Prostrating himself flat and rubbing his head against the rock surface, he dealt with Beatrice’s quiet rage.

In any case, although she teased him, she——

“Are you still… keeping the contract with me?”

“A contract is a contract. It remains valid until one of us falls, in fact…… Thinking of it that way, not setting a proper time limit was a mistake, I suppose.”

Perhaps intending to pretend the earlier nitpicking hadn’t happened in earnest, Beatrice behaved as if she had forgotten the duration Subaru had mentioned.

A foul-mouthed girl with whom he didn’t get along. ——Subaru felt as if his chest had been suddenly struck by the merciful stance shown by Beatrice, who had given such a strong impression.

Subaru lost his words at the emotions welling up.

Beatrice, while gazing at Subaru who had fallen silent, pointed a finger at him without touching on the change in his expression,

“Come to think of it, there was something I had to ask, in fact.”

“……What, is it?”

He instinctively braced himself because, depending on the content of that question, he was wary that an audience with the black mist would be unavoidable.

However, what came out of her mouth was content unrelated to Subaru’s fears,

“About the wounds Betty healed… did you defeat the opponent that inflicted them, I wonder? Or did it escape, I wonder?”

“……? By wounds, do you mean that black wolf-like thing? If it’s that……”

Approaching slowly to the edge of the cliff, he pointed below as if to show Beatrice.

At the tip of his finger, there lay the carcass of the beast, rolling in the same position. Beatrice, standing next to him, confirmed it and nodded,

“Was that the only opponent, I wonder?”

“If there were two or more, I would’ve simply been bitten to death twice as fast.”

Being able to bury one like that was completely a result of coincidence.

If he had been attacked by a pack, a dust cloud would have risen in cartoonish expression, and after it cleared, a clean Subaru skull would likely be rolling there.

At Subaru’s reply, Beatrice touched her own chin and closed her eyes for a moment. Then, she shook her head slightly as if immediately convinced,

“I don’t sense any presence in the surroundings, so it was probably a stray, in fact. If you happened to encounter one that slipped through the barrier, your bad luck is quite something, I suppose.”

“I’m actually at the point of suspecting I’m a clump of bad luck myself.”

It felt like all the misfortunes that occur in a life were weighing on him at once.

Even if it were guaranteed that no misfortune would occur if he got through this, he would want to ask them to switch to releasing it in small doses if possible.

Since coming to the parallel world, what he recalled vividly were only memories accompanied by pain.

Even though there should have been just as many happy things.

Feeling something ache effeminately in the depths of his memory, Subaru cast down his eyes to deceive his expression. But Beatrice didn’t pay attention to such sentimentality of Subaru’s,

“If that’s not the case… well, thinking about this is a waste of time, I suppose.”

“Hey, what? When you figure something out all on your own like that, it makes me curious. I want to see, hear, and touch that fact you realized”

“It would just add one more thing that you can’t do anything about, in fact. More importantly than that, you should rack your brain about how you’ll conduct yourself from now on, I suppose.”

Pushing away the approaching Subaru, Beatrice clearly blocked the retreat of Subaru, who had been searching for an escape route again.

As if to press the point to the silent Subaru, Beatrice crossed her arms,

“Let me tell you, this is as far as Betty can do for you, in fact. I cannot create an opportunity for you to return to the mansion and explain yourself to the older of those sisters, I suppose. Even if that chance existed, you are the one who threw it away, in fact.”

“I……!”

If he could have said it, he wanted to scream that he would have.

If not for that restriction that felt like his heart was being crushed, Subaru would have spilled everything and begged for forgiveness.

That not a single thing would serve as a clue to heal Ram’s heart. That Subaru was also a victim just being swept away by that helpless situation.

Because even that wasn’t allowed, he had run away to a place like this, been attacked by a wild animal, and ended up groveling for his life.

“Am I an idiot…? No, I am definitely an idiot.”

Again, making that situation an excuse, he tried to pretend he didn’t see.

Repeating public stances, excuses, defenses, and self-preservation, Subaru had come to the edge of the cliff. It was proof that he had been driven to a place with no escape, both in a realistic sense and a mental sense.

Running, running, running, and continuing to run; which way were his feet facing now?

“Why do you… care about me when I can’t go back?”

“It’s a whim, in fact. If you don’t at least die somewhere out of my sight, Betty will have bad dreams and be troubled, I suppose. ——Seeing you hesitating even at this late stage, I feel like even that is a faint hope, in fact.”

Erasing kindness, she slashed at him with words filled only with severity.

Beatrice’s gaze, looking at him as if he were something boring, was completely dry, and unknowingly Subaru made his throat sound as if gasping.

“If I, choose to run away……”

“I will at least lend a hand so you aren’t found by the people of the mansion, in fact. As for where you disappear to after that, you should do as you please, I suppose.”

It was a blunt way of speaking, but that was likely her undeniable true feeling.

Beatrice never broke the content of what she voiced. That was clear from the fact that she came to search for Subaru in the mountains like this, and in the end, didn’t abandon him as he crouched effeminately.

Surely, if Subaru chose to run away, she would affirm it.

Not out of consideration, but out of indifference born from weighing the terms of the contract..

But if, hypothetically——

“If I said I wanted to talk to Ram, what would you do?”

“……It’s useless, in fact. The older of the sisters no longer has the composure to listen to your words, in fact. No matter what you say, she won’t listen, and she won’t believe, I suppose.”

To Subaru’s presentation of another choice, Beatrice responded while casting down her eyes, which was rare.

Was the image floating in her mind the figure of Ram raising a voice of resentment, whom Subaru had left behind at the mansion?

How she had been after Subaru ran away. Coming into contact with Beatrice’s current attitude, he knew that it was a situation where he dared not ask.

Seeing Beatrice shut her mouth, Subaru looked up at the sky and chewed on his own foolishness.

That moment, that place was the watershed.

Subaru shouldn’t have run away at that place. Even if he didn’t have the resolve to endure the pain, Subaru should have faced Ram.

He missed the opportunity, and the chance to connect their hearts was lost. And that which had slipped through his hands once could never return a second time.

The rift that had opened between the two was just that deep and large.

“The older of the sisters endured for the sake of the younger. And the younger of the sisters lived for the sake of such an older sister, I suppose. If either is missing, that pair is no longer whole, in fact.”

As if interrupting the silence, the melancholy voice of the girl flowed.

In front of Subaru lowering his gaze, Beatrice toyed with her own luxurious hair,

“If either is missing, the function is lost. Since she has ended up like that, the older sister probably won’t last long either, I suppose.”

“What, does that mean? What do you know……?”

He felt like something outrageous was being muttered.

Closing in on Beatrice with momentum as if about to grab her, Subaru tried to question the true meaning of her statement just now. But,

“You are arrogant, your attitude is big, and your hands and eyes are nasty, human.”

His hand was taken, and Beatrice’s body rotated as if dancing. As if caught up in her rotating movement, his legs got tangled, and before he knew it, he landed on the ground on his back. Air was forcibly expelled from his lungs by the impact, and the groaning Subaru opened his eyes wide.

“It will never go back to how it was. When I think that, I have thoughts of my own, I suppose. Although, Betty may not have the qualification to voice them, in fact.”

“Acting like you understood it all by yourself…… Stop acting like a big shot. Are you blurring the content to act like a key person, you piece of shit.”

Was she amusing herself with the state of the opponent alternating between joy and sorrow by releasing information in small doses? Subaru cursed at that bad taste. However, Beatrice shook her head,

“You’re the one asking; what do you intend to know about an opponent you’ve only known for four days——and barely even faced properly at that, I wonder? Even if you knew, what could you do, I wonder? Don’t force your self-righteousness on me. You can no longer be involved with that mansion, in fact.”

“I don’t……”

“Know anything”, he started to say, but Subaru’s mouth lost the counterargument.

The human named Natsuki Subaru, since waking up in the mansion, had been a suspicious person who stayed shut in his room and didn’t even converse properly until this morning when Rem died.

At least, the Subaru in Beatrice’s subjectivity was nothing more than such a human.

However, even if Subaru told her about the ten days he had experienced, what on earth would come of it?

Looking back on these ten days, could Subaru say he knew anything about them?

To Beatrice, who was now looking down on Subaru with a harsh gaze like this, did he gain anything from those two that would let him argue back?

“In the end, without knowing anything, in a place I didn’t understand anything, was I just making a pathetic racket on my own selfishly……”

——You know nothing.

There was no mistake in Beatrice’s words.

Subaru knew nothing. He didn’t know. He wasted all his chances, and had drifted this far with just his body.

Lying on the ground spread-eagle, Subaru covered his face with his palms and looked at the darkness.

Inside the pitch-black vision, what was recalled were the few days of peace of mind spent at the mansion. Those days shattered into pieces, and Subaru’s heart also shattered.

“So as not to touch the barrier, go through the forest tracing the boundary, in fact. If you get out to the highway beyond the mountain, it shouldn’t be difficult to walk to a human village, I suppose.”

Implicitly, Beatrice was announcing she intended to look after him only that far.

Her contract was, in the truest sense, nothing more than “Subaru’s safety within the range of her reach.” If there was no factor involving her own beliefs there, the fact that Subaru was a stone by the roadside to her did not change.

Beatrice began to walk around as if searching for a spot where he could descend the cliff safely, and he stood up to follow her back absentmindedly.

Leave the mansion, forget everything, and flee somewhere far away. He didn’t know if he could survive, but it was a life he had picked up with so much trouble. Let’s cherish it, cherish it.

“——Pretending I didn’t hear any of that crying voice, huh.”

At the words that slipped out of his mouth, Subaru grabbed his own chest and clenched his teeth.

He heard the voice filled with hatred. The roar of resentment chased after him. A scream covered in curses, saying she would kill him, was slammed into him.

But before that, wasn’t that girl crying?

Something that should have shattered was screaming inside Subaru’s heart.

“Hey, I’m thinking stupid things, aren’t I……”

The back of his throat trembled. The sensation of his stomach being tightened. A shudder like his skin crawling transmitted to his whole body, and the breathing of the standing Subaru became sharp and rough.

He himself thinks that he is thinking stupid things.

It’s a stupid story. It doesn’t fit logic at all. It doesn’t add up, and above all, if he considers the disparity between merits and demerits, it’s a clear story.

“Even an idiot doesn’t need to think to know. That’s right, it’s decided.”

——

Really, are you okay with that

?

“It’s decided that it’s okay. Three cheers, it’s because there is life. All’s right with the world.”

Shaking off the hesitation, he tries to step forward.

But his legs do not obey the brain’s command. He stops on the spot, forcing a dialogue.

Someone’s question. An inner, question of his own.

——

Really, are you okay with that

?

“Like I said, it’s decided, that it’s okay……”

—

—What part of that, makes it okay

?

To his inner question, Subaru cannot find words. Meanwhile, the voice throws questions as if piling them up, demanding an answer.

——

Are you okay with not being able to be involved with that place anymore

?

——

Are you okay with not being able to interact with those people anymore

?

——

Are you okay leaving the people you left behind in that place alone

?

——

Are you okay having shaken off the girl who was crying there?

——

Can you give up on the future that should have been in that place

?

“——Eat shit.”

Against the risk, the possibility of getting a return is too low.

High-risk, high-return? That’s bound to be the most impossible choice in Subaru’s life.

In the first place, the moment he finds himself betting on something, it’s safe to call it a loss, judging by Subaru’s way of living.

Not getting deeply involved with anything, not choosing anything, just drifting.

Since he had lived that way, since it would have been fine if he could live that way, why not do so even after coming to this world?

“After all that trouble… right, after all that struggle, this is a life I worked so hard to pick up, isn’t it?”

Pretending not to see the bonds he had gained, betraying the warmth that certainly should have been there, brushing away even the mercy of heaven that visited at the destination he fled to; if the conclusion he reaches at the end of that is this, isn’t his current self too much of a clown?

“No, since it doesn’t even make a funny story, a clown is far better.”

A clown who behaves comically and can’t make anyone, let alone himself, laugh. What value is there in such a thing?

Subaru doesn’t know, and doesn’t want to know.

“That’s right. It’s a life I picked up after all that trouble…… So.”

Taking a breath, he raised his face.

“——I decide how to use it.”

The conflicting hearts matched, and Subaru’s will was unified.

Suddenly, a cool breeze blowing through swayed his bangs, and Subaru narrowed his eyes at the ticklishness. In the distant sky, over there, the sunset was sinking while dyeing the world orange.

The sun of the fifth day he had wanted to see so much was vanishing toward the end.

While seeing it off, Subaru finally remembered.

For what purpose he had waited so eagerly for that sun.

“——Get back, I suppose.”

Suddenly muttering in a low voice, Beatrice stepped around toward Subaru.

She restrained Subaru’s movement with a raised hand, and carving a color of deep vigilance onto her lovely features, she ran her gaze around the surroundings.

“Bea……”

“Silence, in fact.”

The question was cut off immediately, and Subaru also wandered his gaze as if searching for the cause of her vigilance.

He didn’t know what Beatrice felt or what she was wary of.

Therefore, that Subaru found it first was simply a gift of coincidence.

“——Ram.”

The pink-haired girl indicated by the mutter was finding Subaru and smiling beautifully.

Her figure was high in the sky, at the summit of a large tree stretching high. Ram, using a thick branch as a foothold and supporting her body with a hand on the trunk.

The moment her gaze and Subaru’s gaze entangled and he unconsciously swallowed his breath, something shaved the earth and kicked up a cloud of dust around Subaru and the other.

“

Gwoh

!”

While being bathed in the raging earth and sand, Subaru reflexively covered his face. When he lowered his arms timidly after a few seconds, a rock face gouged in a semicircle was left before his eyes.

At the destructive power of that phenomenon, a chill ran down Subaru’s spine. It wasn’t a shudder from imagining himself receiving it.

——He shuddered because he remembered what he was like when he actually did.

“From that time……”

Last time, Subaru fleeing while being chased by Rem in the mountains. There was a blow that blew off his right leg and finally gouged his neck.

Invisible slashes, the identity of the opponent who released them. He had never let his thoughts run there, but,

“So it was the two of them……”

Thud; there was a sensation of a lump that had accumulated in his chest falling.

He knew it was foolish to think so, but what Subaru felt at that moment was the desolation of realizing that even she had abandoned him, along with a mysterious sense of relief.

Subaru tilted his head at himself for obtaining relief.

Thinking such out-of-place sentiments like, as expected, they are only themselves when they are two.

“Found, in fact. ——That girl’s Clairvoyance is troublesome, I suppose.”

“Clairvoyance, huh……”

An ability with a grandiose name; it’s to Subaru’s liking.

As Beatrice’s grave tone indicated, her movements from there were rapid. Ram bent her body and descended from the trunk of the large tree as if sliding.

Landing with quite some momentum, but without killing that momentum, she rode it into a sprint, and with a single leap to the foothold of Subaru and the other midway up the cliff——arrival.

“Finally, Ram found you. Lady Beatrice still being with you is unexpected, though.”

As if facing a hated enemy, Ram said this with shining eyes.

Seeing those young features distorted by hatred, painfulness swept through Subaru’s heart.

Her clothes were the usual maid outfit, but that attire usually worn methodically was now distorted beyond recognition.

Holes were scattered on the skirt snagged here and there, the white brim she had worn on her head had vanished somewhere, and the pink hair that should have been arranged was disheveled and had lost its grace.

——Dressing, and hair care; the two of them used to do it for each other.

Subaru knew that too. He remembered them talking about it, sometime.

There are other things, many things he knows.

“Step back, in fact. By contract, Betty protects this human. Even if the opponent is you, I will show no mercy, I suppose.”

“Lady Beatrice, please move. Ram also cannot hold back when the opponent is Lady Beatrice.”

“An amusing joke, in fact. Did you use the words ‘hold back’ in regard to Betty, I wonder?”

“Lady Beatrice, surely you have forgotten that this is not inside the mansion. Far from the Forbidden Library, and in a forest——under these conditions, do you have confidence you can protect that gentleman from Ram?”

In front of the silent Subaru, the fierce check of the two girls continued.

From the reaction of Beatrice narrowing her eyes in frustration, it was conveyed that Ram’s hardline attitude was not a bluff.

Beatrice’s strength was limited, and it was likely a fact that Ram was advantageous under these conditions. Even so, Beatrice did not try to move from in front of Subaru.

Subaru, while standing behind her,

“

Boi~ng

.”

Grabbed two of her luxurious ringlets with both hands and stretched them with all his might.

He let go. The hair bounced largely with its volume. Bounce, bounce.

“Yup, quite pleasant.”

“Wh, wh, wh, wh……”

Opening her eyes wide, trembling her lips, Beatrice turned around trembling.

Subaru tilted his head at her with a “Hmm?”. Then,

“What are you doing, I suppose!? In this situation, do you want to die, I wonder!?”

“Don’t say stupid things, I don’t wanna die even a little bit. Dying is really, just once at the end of life is enough. Seriously, I think so.”

While saying that, he pulled Beatrice’s shoulder and stepped in front of her as she stumbled.

In front, standing there was Ram staring at him with a dumbfounded face. She heightened her vigilance at Subaru stepping forward, and as if biting her lip,

“Well, you’ve got some nerve. Does that mean you’ve finally resigned yourself?”

“Resigned is a little different. If I had to say…… I’ve made my resolve, I guess.”

“——What.”

Not understanding Subaru’s intention, Ram frowned.

To her, Subaru put his hands together and bowed his head deeply.

“My bad. Because I chickened out, I made you incredibly sad.”

“——! As Ram thought, about Rem, you know something.”

“No, sorry but I really don’t have a clue. Honestly, there’s so much I don’t understand. But.”

Cutting his words, Subaru placed a pause of one breath,

“I decided I’ll start trying to understand the things I don’t understand.”

“At this late hour?! What?!”

At Subaru’s declaration of determination, Ram, who could only feel it as nonsense, barked. She stomped her foot down as if stamping in frustration,

“Rem has already, died! It’s already, irrevocable! Even if you understand something now, what can you do!?”

“I can’t say cool things like I can do something. The result of not being able to do anything is this mess, after all. I know best that my persuasiveness is zero.”

It’s not that he’s becoming defiant. Even now, only regret pierces his chest.

He is disgusted by the degree of his own stupidity, and if he could die of shame, he might be dead.

Even so, acting unsightly, struggling to live unsightly, exposing a helpless shameful state, this is the place he arrived at.

And this conclusion is what he obtained.

“What do you know about Ram, or Rem!?”

“I don’t understand anything, because I didn’t try to know. I remain knowing nothing about the essential parts. But you know…”

For ten days, Subaru walked with them.

They don’t know that, and even if they heard, they wouldn’t understand.

But, Subaru certainly remembers those ten days.

Even if they forget, the things he saw with them, the things he laughed about with them, the things he spent with them; Subaru’s soul remembers.

It’s not that he knows nothing. Subaru knows them.

And, such them——

“You guys don’t know either, do you.”

“What……”

“That I! Love! ——You guys!”

The older sister who is meddlesome despite being blunt.

The younger sister who is sarcastic despite seeming politely rude and courteous.

In the days spent with them, Subaru thought that time was precious.

Even if memories of being killed by their hands remained, both were memories hard to forget.

To the extent that he could think that if he could share that time once more, he wouldn’t mind choosing to do “so.”

At Subaru’s scream, Ram just froze with her eyes wide open in astonishment.

Naturally. From her perspective, Subaru’s statement is nothing but a delusion with unknown meaning. Nothing more than one of thousands of nonsenses uttered by a crazy madman.

Therefore, the judgment to cut him down was made in an instant.

Immediately after her thoughts stopped and her body’s stiffness dissolved, Ram’s hostility was put into action.

But, even an instant of stagnation is stagnation.

“

――――!!

”

Subaru sprinting was just a split second faster than her immediate judgment being carried out.

Turning his back to Ram, passing by Beatrice’s side, Subaru’s body rode on full speed——heading toward the cliff.

“Wait——!”

Behind him, a voice like a girl’s high-pitched scream echoed.

Which girl’s voice that was, did not reach the running Subaru’s consciousness.

His thoughts are a mess. He intended to have made his resolve.

But the beating of his heart sent pain throughout his body as if betraying his mind, and at the tips of his limbs, he felt weight as if lead were packed in.

Despite running with all his might, the world was endlessly slow motion, and he felt as if it were trying to urge a change of heart in Subaru by delaying it even by a second.

Ridiculous. Even now, he is hesitating like this.

If he thinks about it, he understands. He struggled that much, he should have been attached to life.

Even if he thought he wanted to die, in the end, he couldn’t resist the survival instinct.

And yet now, he is doing this.

“I forgot to thank Beatrice, huh……”

Suddenly, voicing the concern that remained, with that, he left everything behind.

The cliff approaches. How many more steps; it’s terrifying to even count. His heart feels like it will break. He feels like it’s already broken. It’s not normal. He’s not sane. An impulse to burst out laughing wells up. Yet he can’t laugh at all. There’s no way he can laugh.

Even if he survived as is, he would just live as if he were dead.

If he gives up the future in that place, that is the same as being dead for Subaru.

If he is going to live a life he picked up as if he were dead, what’s wrong with using it how he likes.

The cliff is right before his eyes. The height is sufficient. At the bottom of the cliff, a previous guest is waiting impatiently for Subaru. He kept it waiting quite a while… 

Sorry, but I can’t go to the same place as you.

“Since a good person like me will end up going to heaven when I die.”

His feet left the ground. Scratching the air. Touching nothing, reaching nothing.

His body wavered. His posture collapsed. Up or down, he cannot maintain balance.

Fast. The wind is strong. His eyes hurt. His head hurts. The ringing in his ears is distant. He feels like he left his heart behind. He can’t hear the pounding; the bell of ill omen rings out.

If it ends by dying, that’s that.

Living as if dead; then it changes nothing.

But if, if hypothetically, he can return.

——Because she screamed, “

I will absolutely kill you

.”

In that case, I

.

“——Will absolutely, save you.”

Immediately after voicing his determination, he crashed headfirst into the hard ground.

The sound of shattering resonated grandly, and anymore, nothing, can be heard.

Even the voice of resentment could not catch up. Anymore, nothing——
